description.default: Browse, preview and edit your NebulaDisk cloud drive files inside SiYuan: sidebar file tree, online preview & editing, embedded file tree / file pages in notes, and open-in-browser with per-type rendering.
description.zh_CN: 在思源笔记中直接浏览、预览和编辑 NebulaDisk 网盘：侧边栏文件树、在线预览与编辑、笔记内嵌文件树或文件页面，以及按类型渲染的「在浏览器中打开」。
